summary_bullets: Implemented the Step 0 phase_tracking state machine in implement-bootstrap.sh, including repo/fork skips, Branch 1 sentinel resume, Branch 2 adoption, deferred metadata handling, tracking bails, and branch-aware final KV output.
Added --forked-target session-env propagation and --run-id support in post-tracking-issue.sh so successful adoption writes the selected RUN_ID into parent-issue.md.
Updated /implement docs and bootstrap contracts, and expanded the offline bootstrap harness to cover tracking success, skip, bail, deferred, mismatch, and malformed sentinel paths.
commit_message:
Implement phase tracking bootstrap adoption

Move Step 0 tracking issue adoption into implement-bootstrap.sh, including sentinel resume, fresh issue adoption, fork/repo skips, explicit deferred/stall flags, and branch-aware final output.

Propagate fork mode through session-env and allow post-tracking-issue.sh callers to pin RUN_ID for sentinel writes.

Expand the bootstrap harness and docs for the new tracking paths.
todos_left: Full make lint still stops in the pre-existing test-review-core harness with /dev/fd operation-not-permitted errors in this sandbox; the changed bootstrap/helper checks and relevant-checks passed.
